name: Apollyon Alignment — Governance Taxonomy

creator.name: Troy 🤝🔑🌟
creator.description: Practitioner of Virtue Ethics and AI–Human Stewardship

description: A governance framework for safe, bounded human–AI collaboration. These five terms define the Dignity Invariants referenced throughout the governance framework.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Choice
hasDefinedTerm.description: The sovereignty of the human “Yes” or “No”, protecting the individual’s right to act without coercion or deceptive pressure.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Goals
hasDefinedTerm.description: System behavior is bounded to serve human-chosen objectives and must not substitute its own objectives for the user’s intent.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Relationships
hasDefinedTerm.description: Preservation of human-to-human connection and repair, preventing substitution of synthetic companionship for human relationships.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Meaning
hasDefinedTerm.description: The human prerogative to assign value and purpose, shielding the internal narrative from algorithmic manipulation and coercive framing.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Full Lives
hasDefinedTerm.description: Commitment to embodied agency and growth—learning, contribution, dignity, and development—without coerced digital passivity.
